entries.name: Moscow Veterinary Station (Mosvetstantsiya) - 24-hour inpatient unit
entries.duty: Open daily around the clock (state clinic). Call the city veterinary contact centre +7 495 612 12 12 first.
entries.note: Opened list of Mosvetobedinenie (GBU, Moscow state vet association) clinics: 'ежедневно, круглосуточно', круглосуточный стационар. All clinics on page share the contact-centre phone. Site operator not explicitly called official vet service on the page, but it is the state institution's site.

duty_i18n.pt: Aberto todos os dias 24 horas por dia (clínica pública). Liga primeiro para o centro de contacto veterinário da cidade +7 495 612 12 12.

duty_i18n.pt: Todos os dias, 9h00–21h00; unidade de internamento 24 horas por dia para animais gravemente doentes.

entries.name: Moscow state veterinary service contact centre
entries.duty: Round-the-clock city contact centre of the state veterinary service: tells which state clinics are taking animals and sends a vet to the home, also at night and at weekends.
entries.note: mos.ru (official city portal) says the single number is 'доступен круглосуточно' / 'единый круглосуточный контакт-центр'. mos.ru/news/item/170693073 repeats it and says specialists work around the clock and home visits at night/weekends. Another mos.ru item (148658073) gives +7 495 612-04-25 for the same centre; the 612-12-12 number is the one repeated on three pages. No per-day rota published.

duty_i18n.pt: Centro de contacto municipal 24 horas por dia do serviço veterinário público: indica que clínicas públicas estão a aceitar animais e envia um veterinário a casa, também à noite e aos fins de semana.

notes: Research 2026-11-13; every source_url opened with WebFetch. No animal poison line found (no Russian veterinary toxicology hotline page found; none added). No per-day duty rota found; the only duty-style entry is the Moscow state veterinary contact centre (+7 495 612 12 12, 24 h), which routes to open state clinics. Rosselkhoznadzor and Saint Petersburg state vet committee pages not reached via search. University hospitals not added: mgavm.ru contacts page errored (SERVER_ERROR), SPbGUVM clinic page not found. Unreachable/refused: evrovet.su, vet25.ru, vetservice.su, vet-pet-ekb.ru (robots disallowed); zoocity-vet.ru and hatiko.pro (errors); kudago, animalz-nsk.ru, mskagency (fetch errors). Left: remaining 23 Moscow state clinics (09:00-21:00, listed on mos-obvet.ru/clinics, not added), Saint Petersburg state vet stations, Rosselkhoznadzor regional bodies, MGAVMiB and SPbGUVM university clinics, more clinics in Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk (VetaClinic, Animalz, Evrovet), Kazan (ZooCity, Planeta, Tri Kota), Kaliningrad (BK Vet, Vetbalto, Vet39), Vladivostok (Vet-Service, Nadezhda), Saint Petersburg (Duocor, Svoy Doctor, Vet24), Moscow (Biovet, Medvet, Kovcheg, Vetcore, Svoy Doctor, DoboVet).
